user.title: Connect Netflix
user.description: On a computer, sign in at netflix.com and pick the profile you want (for example the family profile). Then open the browser's developer tools (Chrome: View → Developer → Developer Tools), go to Application → Cookies → https://www.netflix.com, and copy the Value of NetflixId and SecureNetflixId into the boxes below. These act like a password: they stay in Home Assistant and are only sent to netflix.com.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Netflix
reauth_confirm.description: Netflix signed this connection out (this happens after a password change or every few months). On a computer, sign in at netflix.com and pick the profile you want (for example the family profile). Then open the browser's developer tools (Chrome: View → Developer → Developer Tools), go to Application → Cookies → https://www.netflix.com, and copy the Value of NetflixId and SecureNetflixId into the boxes below. These act like a password: they stay in Home Assistant and are only sent to netflix.com.

error.signed_out: Netflix didn't accept those values. Make sure you copied both, while signed in, with no extra spaces.
error.cannot_read: Signed in, but Netflix's history page answered in a way this doesn't understand yet.

abort.already_configured: That Netflix profile is already connected (its sign-in was updated).

get_history.name: Get Netflix history
get_history.description: Recently watched titles from the connected Netflix profiles.
